name: manage-math-research-program
description: Manage long-running, cross-paper, cross-problem mathematics research programs: project workspaces, literature curation, paper maps, open-problem portfolios, tool libraries, budgets, checkpoints, task packets, delegation to rigorous-open-math-research, and a hash-bound reviewed accepted-knowledge base with blueprint integration. interface.shortDescription: 数学研究项目管理: 文献, 开放问题, 任务包, 已接受知识库.
interface.longDescription: Program management layer for mathematics research: initialize and validate project workspaces, curate literature, maintain paper maps and open-problem portfolios, delegate concrete problems to rigorous-open-math-research, ingest audited artifacts by reference, and maintain a hash-bound, reviewed, canonical accepted-knowledge base.
